name: Okinawa Financial Group, Inc.
summary: Okinawa Financial Group, Inc. provides various financial services in Japan. It operates through two segments, Banking and Leasing. The Banking segment offers deposit, lending, foreign exchange, and securities investment services; over-the-counter sales of government bonds; and trust services; etc. The Leasing segment provides leasing and related business activities. It also offers trading and credit card services, securities, credit guarantee and various consulting services, debt management, cash reckoning and settlement services, debt and collection, and computer related services. In addition, the company provides cash inspection and sorting work, financial and economic survey and research,…
